verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for an online employer filing and payment service. The axis applies, but the evidence shows only interactive e-Services workflows: email verification links and text or phone login verification. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, and the transactional portal returned 403 to an agent. FSET and EFT appear only as payment-method names, with no documented headless or CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
